text:
anna: Who's up for a rooftop watch this Saturday? Game starts 7pm — halfcourt shots for the last-place fantasy loser? :basketball: :sunglasses:

mike: I'm in if there's pizza. also voting for 'loser pays for pizza' rule :joy:

sophia: love this. can we make the tiebreaker a real thing? last-place currently tied between me and @mike in our playoff pool. :thinking:

james: I'll bring folding chairs and a bluetooth speaker. rooftop + halftime highlights = chef's kiss :ok_hand:

anna: Okay tiebreaker proposal: predict the exact number of combined 3-pointers in the game. closest without going over wins the tiebreaker. losers do the halfcourt shot. sound fair?

mike: hmm biased towards shooter-heavy teams but fine. what if everyone goes over? do we take closest absolute diff?

sophia: let's do absolute difference but prefer "without going over" as first rule, then absolute diff as fallback. keeps it spicy.

lunch-bot: Heads up! If you RSVP, please mark dietary prefs in the thread. Poll will auto-close 48h before event.

anna: RSVP below (yes/no) + pizza prefs. starting list: anna - yes (veg), mike - yes (pepperoni), sophia - maybe (vegan option?), james - yes (cheese).

mike: also proposing a 2-ticket side-bet: whoever nails the exact combined 3s gets the extra ticket to pick the halftime playlist. stakes! :fire:

sophia: sold. i'll bring vegan slices if needed. and i call dibs on a very niche 90s pop playlist if i win.

james: can someone post the fantasy standings snapshot before locking picks? wanna be sure we're not misremembering who lost last week.

anna: will paste standings tomorrow morning. quick note — halfcourt shot is optional for safety; if someone opts out they do a harmless silly dare (sing the anthem into the mic). no pressure. :grin:

mike: perfect. count me in. and if i lose, i'll sing badly and pay for pizza. fair trade.

sophia: cool — locking tiebreaker rules: 1) predict combined 3-pointers 2) closest without going over wins 3) if all over, closest absolute difference wins 4) winner picks playlist ticket.

anna: awesome. final call on RSVP by Friday noon. see y'all Saturday! :raised_hands:
